# Boston 25 News

> > Boston 25 News delivers local and national news coverage including breaking stories, politics, crime, consumer protection, and human interest features across Massachusetts and beyond.

Boston 25 News is a Cox Media Group television station providing comprehensive news coverage for the Boston area and New England region. The site features local crime reports, trending national stories, political developments from Congress, and consumer safety guides.

## Key Topics

- Cox Media Group
- Massachusetts local news
- Breaking news coverage
- Crime and public safety
- Congressional politics
- Consumer protection
- Government shutdown coverage
- Federal budget and funding
- Identity theft prevention
- Community stories
- Milwaukee news partnerships
- Associated Press reporting
- Human interest features
- Surveillance and investigations
- Child safety
